title: K-flat reduction-unit counit calculation for integral inverse image
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a scheme isomorphism h:Z -> W, a normalized coefficient-derived system calculus S on W, a normalized Roos model rho on Z and a normalized pullback model F for h [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. For a flat-term K-flat complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex], let a_P be the exact inverse-image localization comparison followed by the explicit zero-homotopy Roos lift of the reduction family and by the inverse of the defining completed-pullback comparison [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Then Delta_Z(a_P followed by F.realization at Q(P)), followed by the whole-tower derived-limit counit at h-star(S.reduction(Q(P))), equals the diagonal/inverse-image commutation followed by H_t(Delta_W(S.unit at Q(P)) followed by the whole-tower counit) and the termwise finite tensor unit at S.reduction(Q(P)) [def-trf-integral-tower-inverse-image-unit]. The equality is in the derived category of entire strict completed-coefficient towers. This is the reduction-unit computation on a K-flat complex, before transport through any resolution or composition with an arbitrary quotient-system morphism.

source.place: Tag 0941, with the whole-diagram coefficient adjunction of Tag 06YY; specialization of steps 1, 3 and 5 of lem-trf-integral-pullback-resolution-matching. Bhatt--Scholze, Lemma 6.5.9(4), supplies the defining Roos lift.

proof.text: Choose a single strict quotient presentation C,e,kappa from S.reductionModel for the flat-term K-flat complex P. The presentation identifies all finite quotients and their transitions simultaneously. Apply F.normalization to this same presentation; it supplies the generator-preserving whole-tower isomorphism q and the realization equation.

Identify the strict diagonal-to-restricted-quotient map r with the unit of whole-system coefficient extension on the sequence site. The diagonal of P is K-flat by the levelwise acyclicity test. The derived coefficient adjunction and left-adjoint uniqueness imply that r is Delta(S.unit) followed by the derived diagonal-limit counit, transported through e. This is an equality of morphisms in the derived category of the whole tower, before finite evaluation.

The generator equation of F.normalization, the section formula defining inverseImageReductionTheta, and the section formula defining integralTowerInverseImageUnit identify theta with inverse-image(r) followed by the finite tensor unit, transported by q. Check every section and every transition; these are strict chain maps, not unrelated maps in finite derived categories.

Resolve the pulled-back whole quotient tower by simultaneous K-injectives. The exact-products strict Roos comparison and rho.computes identify rho with the normalized inverse of the limit-to-Roos inclusion. The cone-counit theorem applied to the strict family theta says that the diagonal image of its Roos lift, followed by the derived-limit counit, is theta. Substitute the realization equation from the first step, the whole-system unit identity from the second step and the strict theta equation from the third step. Naturality of the exact-derived comparisons transports this identity to the displayed equality. No resolution of an arbitrary derived object and no map from the reduction to a second quotient system is involved.

theorem integralPullbackKFlatReductionCounit
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) [IsIso h]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (ρ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E Z)
    (F : IntegralComparisonPullbackModel l E h S ρ)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    (integralComparisonConstantTower l E Z).map
        ((inverseImageIntegralModules l E h).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P.obj ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (inverseImageRoosComparisonComplex l E h P.obj) ≫
          (integralDerivedPullbackComparison l E h).inv.app P ≫
          F.realization.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
        (integralComparisonTowerCounit l E Z).app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Z).obj
            ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E h).obj
              (S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))) =
      (integralTowerInverseImageDiagonal l E h).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫
        (integralDerivedTowerInverseImage l E h).map
          ((integralComparisonConstantTower l E W).map
              (S.adjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
            (integralComparisonTowerCounit l E W).app
              ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E W).obj
                (S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))) ≫
        (integralDerivedTowerInverseImageUnit l E h).hom.app
          (S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
